verdict.rationale: Muse's own safety blog says users can opt out of model training entirely with a simple switch in Muse settings. It also documents that by default, trajectories are sanitized of key PII before training, so the user controls a product-level setting. Missing for 10: detailed settings documentation (where the switch lives, whether it applies retroactively or covers all clients such as WhatsApp) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models

citations.quote: If you do not want your data to be used in model training at all, you can opt-out via a simple switch in Muse settings.
